items.summary: MIOpen FP16 Winograd forward convolution overflows to inf/NaN for inputs whose exact output is far inside the FP16 range. gfx1100 (Radeon PRO W7800), TheRock ROCm 10.2.0a20261022 MIOpen: ConvWinoFuryRxS<2-3> (chosen by default) turns a 512x512x3x3 conv with one input channel at +-30000 (exact output max 3360) into all-inf; ConvBinWinogradRxSf2x3g1 fails the same way at +-40000 (exact max 4480); MIOPEN_DEBUG_CONV_WINOGRAD=0 is finite with max abs error <1. Seen in LivePortrait Animals mode (spade_generator G_middle_5.conv_1, input absmax 38304, exact output max 12689 -> 2048 inf -> black boxes). Reproducer and draft issue in LivePortrait notes, Porting 2026-11-23.
